There's a theory that media works like a
funnel. You make entertaining content and then the theory states that people
who watch that content then will go to more educational content. Okay? Sounds
simple enough. We've got something wide, we've got something narrow. Fantastic.
In my experience, it works much more like entertainment people want more
entertainment content and education people want more education content. And
so in other words, these people do not become these people. So if I want more
of these people, then they deserve the stuff that they value. All views are not
created equal.
